Dear {vendor} team,

Thank you for your notice that the price of our {plan} plan under {agreement} will change. We understand the new rate of {new_price} takes effect on {effective_date}, up from {old_price}.

We would like to keep our current price. Before the new rate applies, we ask that you review our account and let us know whether you can hold the rate at {old_price}, or propose other options such as a longer term commitment, a different plan level, or a phased increase.

Please reply by {deadline} so we can decide our next steps before the billing date. We would welcome a short call to discuss this.

Thank you for your attention to this request.

Kind regards,
{sender}
